mintAuthority.summary: ZYS is minted and redeemed through Zephyr's native consensus conversion between ZSD and ZYS at the protocol yield-share price. The pinned v2.3.0 source exposes user-facing MINT_YIELD and REDEEM_YIELD transaction types with RingCT amount-conservation checks and no admin or emergency mint route.

controls.label: Zephyr native ZSD-to-ZYS conversion rules
controls.capDescription: ZYS issuance burns user-supplied ZSD and mints ZYS at the consensus yield-share rate; the reviewed binary exposes no privileged supply-creation path.
controls.evidence: At the still-current Zephyr v2.3.0 commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a, source/destination asset identity deterministically selects MINT_YIELD only for ZSD-to-ZYS conversion and REDEEM_YIELD only for ZYS-to-ZSD conversion. RingCT verification derives the expected minted amount from the consensus yield price and 0.1% conversion fee, then enforces balance conservation. The transaction enum contains no admin, foundation, or emergency mint type; Explorer block 837231 confirms the live network remains on HF11.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. GitHub still identifies v2.3.0 at commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a as the latest official release, and Explorer block 837231 confirms the live network remains on HF11. ZYS is a native consensus asset, so an EVM-style owner or proxy slot is not the relevant authority interface. The pinned transaction router permits ZYS creation only when a user converts ZSD through MINT_YIELD; the RingCT verifier calculates the minted quantity from the consensus yield price, applies the protocol fee, and rejects an imbalanced proof. ZYS issuance is a native consensus conversion, not an issuer-backend reserve reconciliation path, so reconciliation is explicitly not-applicable. No privileged mint transaction type or key-controlled bypass exists in the reviewed current source.
